name: Pobal HP Deprivation Index (2022, by Electoral Division)
description: The Pobal HP Deprivation Index for 2022, by Trutz Haase and Jonathan Pratschke for Pobal, calculated from Census 2022, for the Electoral Divisions of the Republic of Ireland. Each ED is shaded by its relative index category. The relative score is scaled so that 0 is the national average: a lower (more negative) score is more disadvantaged and a higher score more affluent. The categories are Pobal's 10-point bands, from 1 'extremely disadvantaged' (below -30, darkest) through 'marginally below average' (-10 to 0) and 'marginally above average' (0 to 10) to 8 'extremely affluent' (30 and above, lightest). Clicking an ED shows the score, Pobal's label, the population and the census indicators behind the index (age dependency, lone parents, primary-only and third-level education, and male and female unemployment). The relative score compares each ED with the rest of the State in 2022 only, so it says which areas are more or less deprived than others, not how deprived an area is in absolute terms. It cannot be compared across years, and it cannot be compared with the Northern Ireland Multiple Deprivation Measure, which ranks areas on different indicators (there, rank 1 is the most deprived). The figures are drawn on Civgraph's 2022 Electoral Division map (eds-2022, the CSO census EDs: 3,420 mapped units, 30 of them groups of two or three EDs that the CSO publishes together, and three EDs drawn in two parts), matched to Pobal's own ED map by area. Every one of the 3,420 mapped units has a value; 3,408 overlap their Pobal unit by 90% or more, and the rest, a few city EDs, by at least 80%, the difference being the two maps' generalisation; every ED code also agrees with Pobal's. Source: Pobal HP Deprivation Index, Electoral Division 2022 (Pobal, https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=4f379645b4004151a28f3d62d299192d), licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0); the same figures are in Pobal's "Deprivation Index Scores 2022" on data.gov.ie (https://data.gov.ie/dataset/pobal-hp-deprivation-index-scores-2022).
